name: Moloco
hq: California, USA (job board lists Menlo Park, CA; several profiles list Redwood City, CA)
business_model: ML-driven advertising platform: a mobile app demand-side platform (Moloco Ads), Moloco Commerce Media for retailers and marketplaces to run their own sponsored-ads business, and streaming monetization.
ownership: private (Bloomberg reported in January 2026 that it is weighing an IPO)
overview: Moloco runs a real-time bidding platform on Google Cloud that grew from about 550,000 to over 5 million bid requests per second, using Bigtable for campaign history and BigQuery for analytics (m1). A 2024 conference talk described replacing a Bigtable-based in-house query layer with Apache Pinot/StarTree for real-time ad analytics at about 10 PB processed daily (m3). Its Commerce Media business stores behavioral data in Bigtable to serve sponsored recommendations in milliseconds (m2).

sources.title: How Moloco handles 5 million+ ad requests per second with Cloud Bigtable
sources.publisher: Google Cloud blog (authored by Moloco VP of Engineering)
sources.excerpt: Bid requests grew from ~550K to 5M+ per second; 100 ms internal deadline under a 150 ms exchange limit; Bigtable + Memorystore hold campaign history; bid logs stream into BigQuery and GCS for Vertex AI retraining; 3,000+ GKE VMs.

sources.title: Moloco: Bringing ML-powered retail media advertising technology to the world
sources.excerpt: Undated (context suggests ~2023). Retail Media Platform keeps all behavioral data in Bigtable to serve sponsored recommendations within milliseconds; BigQuery runs pre-processing, experiments and ad reports; ~600B bid requests daily; 35,000+ advertisers.

sources.title: Moloco: Apache Pinot and StarTree Smooth AdTech Company's Journey to Real-Time Ad Analytics
sources.publisher: StarTree (vendor user story of a 2024 Real-Time Analytics Summit talk)
sources.excerpt: In-house query framework on Bigtable struggled with 40-50 dimension, high-cardinality queries (up to 10 min). Moved internal performance portal and A/B testing analytics to Pinot/StarTree: 100+ tables, ~100 TB, ingest from BigQuery; queries now sub-2 s.

sources.title: Fidelity-Backed Ad Tech Platform Moloco Is Said to Weigh IPO
sources.excerpt: Reports, citing people familiar, that Moloco is in early talks with advisers about a possible IPO. Article was paywalled; details read via search summary.

sources.title: Moloco sets sights on web and connected TV ad expansion
sources.excerpt: CEO Ikkjin Ahn said the company has been profitable for over four years and framed a future IPO as a milestone for its commerce media positioning rather than a fundraising need. Read via search summary.

sources.title: Moloco careers job board
sources.excerpt: Accessed 2026-10-14: 41 open roles incl. Group PM GenAI Creatives, Director of PM Ads Quality - Moloco Commerce Media, Senior SWE Common Infrastructure (Ads Infrastructure), Experiment Platform; offices Menlo Park, Seattle, Seoul.

sources.title: Moloco: Helping mobile app developers thrive
sources.excerpt: Older, undated story: GKE bidding servers handled 550K+ bid requests/s backed by SSD Bigtable; BigQuery serves analytics and dashboards for Moloco and customers, with queries cut from minutes to ~10 seconds.

tech_signals.detail: Low-latency store for campaign history in the bidding path and for all behavioral data behind Commerce Media recommendations.
Used alongside Bigtable for campaign history lookups at bid time.
Receives streamed bid logs; used for ML pre-processing, experiments, ad performance reports and customer dashboards; batch source for Pinot.
Real-time analytics for the internal performance portal and A/B testing; 100+ tables, ~100 TB.
Model training (TPUs for transformer recommenders) and real-time inference over gRPC.
Hosts bidding services (3,000+ VMs as of 2022).

buying_signals.title: Already outgrew one analytics layer and adopted a real-time OLAP engine
buying_signals.detail: Moloco replaced a Bigtable-based in-house query framework that took up to 10 minutes on high-cardinality queries with Pinot/StarTree. This shows real-time analytics is a funded, important workload, but it also means an incumbent engine is now in place, so this is a competitive displacement, not a greenfield need.

buying_signals.title: Multiple data copies between Bigtable, BigQuery and Pinot
buying_signals.detail: Bid logs flow to BigQuery, Pinot ingests in batch from BigQuery and GCS, and serving reads from Bigtable/Memorystore. Several hops for the same event data.

buying_signals.title: Commerce Media growth and possible IPO
buying_signals.detail: Commerce Media is a strategic growth line and Moloco is reportedly weighing an IPO; retailer partners typically expect customer-facing, real-time campaign reporting. Business momentum, not a stated data need.

buying_signals.title: Hiring in GenAI creatives, ads infrastructure and experimentation
buying_signals.detail: Open roles in GenAI Creatives, Common Infrastructure and Experiment Platform show investment in AI products and platform; no posting viewed names a database evaluation.

initiatives.title: Real-time ad analytics on Pinot/StarTree
initiatives.detail: Moving internal performance and A/B testing analytics from batch/Bigtable queries to real-time OLAP.

initiatives.title: Moloco Commerce Media
initiatives.detail: ML retail-media platform letting retailers run their own performance ads businesses, built on Bigtable, BigQuery, GKE and TPUs.

initiatives.title: GenAI creatives
initiatives.detail: Product leadership role open for GenAI creatives in Ads Product.

architectural_fit.rationale: Extreme-throughput ingest, millisecond serving and high-cardinality real-time analytics spread across Bigtable, BigQuery and Pinot fit SingleStore's real-time analytics + operational profile; SingleStore runs on GCP.

buying_signals.rationale: No current public signal of dissatisfaction; real-time analytics was recently re-platformed onto Pinot.

workload_relevance.rationale: Bid-time lookups, ad performance analytics and retail-media reporting are core real-time, high-concurrency workloads.

organizational_fit.rationale: Strongly Google Cloud-native and willing to adopt specialist engines; profitable and growing, but a new engine must beat managed GCP services and Pinot.

evidence_confidence.rationale: Architecture details come from vendor-hosted stories (Google Cloud 2022, StarTree 2024) authored or presented by Moloco engineers; no 2025-2026 first-party engineering post found.

verified_facts.fact: Moloco's bid request volume grew from about 550,000 to more than 5 million per second, with a 100 ms internal processing deadline.
Bigtable stores campaign history for bidding and behavioral data for Commerce Media recommendations.
Moloco moved real-time ad analytics from a Bigtable-based query framework to Apache Pinot/StarTree, cutting complex queries from up to 10 minutes to under 2 seconds.
Moloco's Pinot deployment spans 100+ tables and about 100 TB, ingesting batch data from BigQuery.
Bloomberg reported in January 2026 that Moloco is weighing an IPO.

inferences.inference: Event data likely flows through several systems (Bigtable, BigQuery, GCS, Pinot), creating data movement and freshness gaps between serving and analytics.
Commerce Media's retailer customers will need real-time, customer-facing reporting, which raises concurrency requirements beyond internal dashboards.
Since Pinot ingests from BigQuery in batch, some analytics may not be truly real-time end to end.

unknowns: Whether Pinot now ingests from streams (Kafka/Pub/Sub) or only batch from BigQuery.
Whether Commerce Media reporting for retailers runs on Pinot, BigQuery or something else.
Use of any vector database for retrieval or GenAI creatives.
Current named engineering leaders (2022 Google blog was authored by the then VP of Engineering; not reverified for 2026).
Exact HQ city (Menlo Park vs Redwood City).
discovery_questions: How fresh is the data in your Pinot analytics today, and is end-to-end streaming ingest a goal?
Which Commerce Media reporting is customer-facing, and what concurrency and latency do retailers expect?
How many copies of bid and event data exist across Bigtable, BigQuery and Pinot, and what does keeping them in sync cost?
Is there a need to combine bid-time point lookups with aggregations over the same data?
How are you approaching retrieval for sponsored products and GenAI creatives: embeddings, vector search, or both?
opportunity_hypothesis: Hypothesis to validate: Moloco's real-time ad data spans Bigtable for serving, BigQuery for logs and Pinot for analytics, and Commerce Media growth will push more customer-facing, high-concurrency reporting. SingleStore on GCP could serve as a single engine for fresh retailer-facing analytics or bid-feature serving, reducing hops between stores. Because Pinot was adopted recently, start with a workload Pinot does not cover today, such as retailer reporting or combined lookup + aggregation, rather than a head-on replacement.

outreach.persona: Engineering lead, Ads Data / Analytics platform
outreach.subject: Real-time analytics for Moloco Commerce Media
outreach.body: Hi - I saw the 2024 Real-Time Analytics Summit talk on moving Moloco's performance portal and A/B testing analytics from a Bigtable-based query layer to Pinot, with complex queries going from minutes to seconds. As Commerce Media grows, I'm curious how you're approaching retailer-facing reporting and how fresh that data needs to be. SingleStore runs on Google Cloud and combines streaming ingest, point lookups and real-time aggregations in one SQL engine. Would you be open to comparing notes on one workload, for example retailer reporting, to see if it is worth a closer look?
